ios.desc:
Calm stress and anxiety with simple daily habits.
  Journal your thoughts, track your mood, and breathe easier every day.
  Rated 4.8 stars by users worldwide.

  My Wellbeing is a mental health app that helps you journal freely, practice mindfulness, and build
  positive routines that last. Whether you want a gratitude journal, a mood tracker, daily affirmations,
  or guided breathing, everything is designed to feel simple, calming, and private.

  A complete mental health routine in one app

  Journal your thoughts freely
  Write unlimited journal entries anytime, even for past days. This is your private space to process
  emotions and reflect with clarity.

  Track your mood and milestones
  Use built in mood tracking and a simple timeline to understand your emotional patterns and celebrate
  your progress.

  Practice daily affirmations
  Strengthen your mindset with guided affirmations made to reduce stress and build lasting confidence.

  Calm your mind with breathing exercises
  Ease anxiety in minutes with guided breathing sessions, soothing music, and immersive backgrounds.

  Stay consistent with widgets
  See your affirmations right on your Lock Screen and Home Screen so you stay aligned with your goals.

  Sync with Apple Health
  With your permission, mindful minutes are saved to the Health app so your mental wellness is tracked
  alongside your physical health.

  Read expert wellbeing insights
  Explore practical articles on mindfulness, self care, stress relief, and personal growth in the My
  Wellbeing Blog.

  Works with Apple Watch for mindfulness on the go.

  Unlock more with Pro

  Attach multiple photos to every journal entry
  Explore affirmations across 40 plus focused topics
  Enjoy immersive breathing experiences with visual backgrounds
  Save and build your own collection of inspiring wisdom

  Designed for anyone committed to daily self care and mental growth, Pro costs less than a coffee each
  month.

  Start free. Cancel anytime.

  Whether you are starting a journaling habit, deepening your mindfulness routine, or looking for a
  trusted mental health app, My Wellbeing helps you build daily practices that support emotional
  strength and lasting clarity.

  Your mental health journey starts today. Download My Wellbeing now.

  Privacy Policy: https://mywellbeing.me/privacy-policy/
  Terms of Use: https://mywellbeing.me/terms-and-conditions/
